# Southeast Asian Financial Sector Deep Dive Analysis

Report 091 | Published 2022-08-21 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2022-8-21/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/091.json)

Currency buffers, banks and censorship.

The most useful distinctions concern debt denomination and institutional choke points. Ethereum censorship concerns had observable inclusion-delay consequences, but not complete exclusion; privacy and legal claims need narrower definitions. The inflation peak is retrospective confirmation of revised timing. DBS and HDFC five-year theses are unfinished, while the DBS retail-crypto statement was already inconsistent with issuer guidance. Bitcoin's first three-year direction and Russian oil diversion worked.

**Coverage:** All article text blocks were read. Ledger covers material macro, investment, and causal propositions; incidental descriptive statistics, boilerplate, and unreasoned position lists are excluded. Image labels were read, not image pixels.

Reserve buffers, maturity and foreign liabilities matter, as BIS and frozen Russian reserves illustrate. Gross reserves can be encumbered and a trade surplus need not stabilize an exchange rate if capital outflows dominate. A risk-screen framework is not a short-term currency forecast.

**Direction:** Not independently resolved; see rationale.

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Global liquidity: a new phase?](https://www.bis.org/publications/qr-202312/global-liquidity-new-phase) | BIS | 2023-12-04 | Verified in the audit

Dollar-credit growth turned from +6% in Q3 2021 to -4% at end-2022; EME dollar credit fell 5% year-on-year by mid-2023, coinciding with stronger USD and tighter policy.

- [Immobilised Russian reserves](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2024/02/12/immobilised-russian-assets-council-decides-to-set-aside-extraordinary-revenues/) | Council of the EU | 2024-02-12 | Verified in the audit

About EUR 260b in central-bank assets remained immobilised across G 7, EU and Australia; freezing differs from confiscation.

## Verification limitations

- Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
- Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
- Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
